title: cli.v1
description: One row of `<cli> cli spec`: a command, a positional or an option of the CLI's argparse tree (the core's commands and the consumer's [plugins].commands). Rows are sorted by cmd, then kind (command, positional, option), positionals in argument order and options by name, so the JSONL is deterministic. Generated, never data.

cmd.description: The command path, space-joined, e.g. `crawl resume`.

opt.description: An option's long form (e.g. `--approve-network`) or a positional's name; null on a command row.

takes_value.description: False for a flag (its presence is the value) and on a command row.

default.description: The default as text; null for none, for a flag and on a command row.

declared.description: On a command row: its pipeline.toml [[stages]] or [[utilities]] entry, or null when undeclared. Always null on an argument row.

position.description: A stage's place in the order (Stage N/M); null for a utility.
